name: mermaid
title: Mermaid
description: Diagrams from the md, the renderer rides with the ware: the author places the plugin's tag {{mermaid:<name>}} into a page's md, and the diagram's data lives in its own md file in the page's mermaid/ folder (created by the plugin on the first save). Installed and enabled, the serve-time filter resolves every tag against that tray and mermaid itself — bundled in the ware's assets, no CDN — renders the diagram in the browser. A tag whose data file is missing degrades to a visible notice. The editor-block insert drops the tag into the canvas; the diagram route (save/list/delete) is the tray's door.
